proposal_title: T2 (Instrument) – Void Lensing Cross-Correlation Meter v1

hypotheses.statement: On mocks with known wall profiles, the meter recovers stacked wall slopes with coefficient of determination R^2_wall >= 0.98 in the designated wall region.
On mocks with and without compensation shoulders, the shoulder-detection classifier achieves AUROC_sh >= 0.90.
On mock suites with known interface-count scaling exponents β, the meter’s estimate of β is unbiased within |β_est - β_true| <= 0.1 over the targeted radial range.
